problem: json!(turns/settings) traversed and copied private decoded trees before encoding the snapshot. Post-ownership dispatch remains ~80% IR; the actual snapshot construction probe found845 allocations and~53us for the existing14KB response.
decision: Borrow private turns/settings/window in lexical-order SyncSnapshotResponse, serialize once under the shared unchanged whole-response byte ceiling. Retain original json!(attempts) conversion: RawValue bytes may be noncanonical and must normalize as before. No source/owner/depth/projection/deadline validation, frame/IR bounds or request watchdog is bypassed. No cache/thread/format added.
alternatives: Raw attempt splicing changes bytes for valid noncanonical source; rejected, original conversion retained.
Skip response grammar/depth or byte validation: integrity/budget regression, rejected.
Parsed response cache: retains invalidation/memory/lifecycle cost and leaves cold copies, rejected.
Treat microprobe74pct as full read gain or delete adverse capacity legs: invalid attribution, rejected.

probe.scope: Single-thread response-construction microprobe from actual decoded public snapshot. microprobe.prototype_scope: Snapshot response borrows private turns/settings; retains original json!(attempts) RawValue conversion and shared whole-response byte budget. No new cache/thread/format. Pending full tests/default-off end-to-end benchmark; no production speedup or integration claim.
